# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v1.2.0

Feature-hardening release for the local-first C300X Home Assistant custom
integration. It updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.2.0`.

## Changed

- Centralizes media-state decisions for on-demand camera video, Ring Calls, Home
  Calls and external media ownership, so the camera entity, services and bundled
  cards agree on the current media state.
- Adds configurable audio gain for live doorstation audio and Ring Call
  captures in the integration options.
- Keeps bundled doorstation and Home Call cards on the same camera-derived
  media state, reducing manual state-entity setup for normal installations.
- Keeps detailed device-agent diagnostics disabled by default, but adds readable
  context showing the current status and why it changed.
- Adds media safety handling for sustained high device CPU load so Home
  Assistant can stop local media sessions and raise a repair issue.

## Fixed

- Avoids repeated Home Assistant state writes when the device agent sends an
  unchanged diagnostics payload.
- Keeps Ring Call preview, answer and hang-up decisions aligned with the current
  native media state while preserving the public services and card type.
- Keeps Ring Call capture and announcement talkback readiness aligned with the
  1.2.0 agent status model, preventing false readiness timeouts after audio is
  already active.
- Blocks Ring Call capture cleanly when the same Ring Call media path is
  already in use by a card/browser.
- Improves Ring Call talkback keepalive reliability while capture or
  announcement playback is active.
- Resets stale Ring Call media state after close events so the card does not
  stay on **Hang Up** after the call has ended.
- Reports failed Home Assistant only binary routing or display patch setup steps as failures
  instead of accepting a partial setup state.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating so the refreshed frontend and services
  are loaded.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant before testing media
  features.
- Hard-reload the browser or Home Assistant mobile app WebView if a dashboard
  still uses an old cached Lovelace card.
- Local Ring Call captures and analysis files remain runtime artifacts under
  `/media/c300x/`, `/config/www/c300x/` or `/config/c300x/` and must not be
  committed.
